messages:
Priya: FYI EdgeBox (HW partner) reported duplicate per-minute meter lines for ~0.8% of devices during DST cutover. Some events show identical `minute` but different `event_id`.
George: ouch. duplicates will inflate billing if we don't dedupe. do we have a preferred dedupe key?
Liam: we normally dedupe on (edge_instance_id, seqno) for Partnersat. EdgeBox doesn't send seqno, only `event_id` UUID. duplicates look like same minute, different UUIDs but identical `payload_hash`. example row: `event_id=6f8...; minute=2026-11-07T01:30-08:00; device_id=eb-42; usage=1.0; payload_hash=abc123`
Priya: So payload_hash can be our dedupe key. But timezone offset variance (+/-1h) on DST makes `minute` ambiguous. We should normalize to UTC bucket (floor to minute UTC) before dedupe.
George: agree. Proposed rules: 1) normalize minute -> UTC minute 2) dedupe by (device_id, utc_minute, payload_hash) 3) if same device_id+utc_minute but different payload_hash and total usage > threshold -> mark for manual review.
Liam: also suggest provisional path for ambiguous timezone records received within 2h of DST transition: tag `provisional:true` and hold final ledger impact until reconciliation window closes. we can set `claim_deadline = now + 48h` for DST windows.
Priya: For entitlements, provisional should decrement a "soft-held" bucket. It shows downstream in Console with a little clock icon and does not count toward invoice until finalization. Billing team: ok? @BillingBot
BillingBot: Billing policy: Soft-held usage reduces available credits but not finalized invoiced usage. If provisional remains after claim_deadline, system will either finalize (if duplicate/confident) or issue credit reversal per partner SLA. Default reversal = 100% of provisional unless partner replay confirms.
George: Need partner contract language for DST edgecases. Also request EdgeBox include `event_seqno` in firmware v2 (monotonic per device) so we can switch to seqno dedupe.
partner-bot: EdgeBox ops: firmware v2 with `event_seqno` planned for rollout 2026-10-15. They can also add `payload_hash` in the event now.
Liam: Infra implementation notes: - Preprocess pipeline: convert minute -> utc_minute, compute payload_hash if missing - If within DST-transition window or missing seqno -> mark provisional and set claim_deadline_ts - Dedupe using device_id+utc_minute+payload_hash, store canonical_event_id - Reconciliation job: hourly; match incoming replays to provisional via payload_hash or event_seqno; finalize or reverse. metrics: dst_provisional_rate, dst_reconcile_lag, dst_manual_review_count.
Priya: Action items: - @Liam open ingest PR for utc normalization + payload_hash (target EOD) - @George draft contract amendment for DST/duplicate policy - @EdgeBox (ops) confirm adding payload_hash now and seqno rollout date - @BillingBot coordinate invoice UI label for "soft-held" usage
Liam: adding feature flag `dst-provisional` for canary rollout.
Priya: Thx. Can we reconvene after ingest PR review? 30m? :calendar:
